connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: WebDAV server connection supporting RFC 4918 operations using async I/O via `HttpClientIo::HttpClientConnectionManager`. This is the preferred connection type for new code; the legacy `webdav`/`webdavs` schemes built on the synchronous `HTTPClient` remain available for backward compatibility.
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: 支援 RFC 4918 操作的 WebDAV 伺服器連線，透過 `HttpClientIo::HttpClientConnectionManager` 使用非同步 I/O。這是新程式碼的首選連線類型；為保持相容性，舊版的 `webdav`/`webdavs` 方案（基於同步 `HTTPClient`）仍可使用。
WebDAV（非同步 I/O）

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: Selects the HTTP protocol used by the async connection manager: `auto` (default; HTTP/3 preferred, falls back to HTTP/2 then HTTP/1.1), `h1`, `h2`, or `h3`.
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: 選擇非同步連接管理員使用的 HTTP 協定：`auto`（預設；優先使用 HTTP/3，若不可用則回退至 HTTP/2，再回退至 HTTP/1.1），`h1`，`h2`，或 `h3`。
HTTP 協定
